name: Molecular Biology
summary: How genetic information is stored, copied, repaired and expressed: DNA, chromosomes, replication, transcription and translation.

topics.name: Discovery of DNA as the genetic material and the double helix
Chromosome structure: nucleosomes, chromatin packing and genome organisation
DNA replication: origins, polymerases, the replisome and telomeres
DNA damage and repair pathways: mismatch, excision, double-strand break repair
Transcription in bacteria and eukaryotes: RNA polymerases and promoters
RNA processing: capping, splicing and polyadenylation
The genetic code and transfer RNA
Translation: ribosomes, initiation, elongation and termination
Protein folding, post-translational modification and targeting
Gene regulation in bacteria: operons, repressors and activators
Gene regulation in eukaryotes: transcription factors and enhancers (overview)
